apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.7 — LoopLab fix: tapping Edit on a loop's Swaras now pushes the swara editor reliably. The push was registered inside the Loops tab content, which the lazy page stack could tear down mid-push, collapsing navigation back to the song list; the presentation state and the push now live on the song detail page itself.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
